# data-editor-table: current Workspace integration

Version 0.4.0 introduces a breaking Workspace API. Release 0.3.1 uses the previous
API; do not mix its integration examples with the current package.
The old integration guide is retained at docs/archive/llms-v0.3.1.txt.

Start with README.md and docs/workspace-migration.md for current integration.
The public exports are src/index.ts (React) and src/engine.ts (headless).
The current demo source is under demo/src; GitHub Pages hosts its production build.

## Ownership rules

- Create and retain a Workspace outside React render; pass it to DataGrid.
- Keep field IDs, entity lifetime IDs and presentation column IDs distinct.
- Use the complete versioned PersistenceSource protocol with exact operation
  receipts and lookup. Do not replace workspace state with a rows prop after save.
- Retain original input and unresolved operations across view unmounts.
- Use explicit close, checkpoint and recovery operations. Old recovery formats
  require retained-work export; they are not automatically converted.
- Do not use the removed GridController or cell-type registry APIs.

## Verification and current limits

Use the commands in README.md. Unit coverage is collected with pnpm test:coverage;
it does not include browser execution.

The refactor is still undergoing acceptance. Read docs/state-kernel-acceptance.md
and docs/test-suite-audit.md for verified behavior and remaining gaps.
Do not infer full design completion or large-dataset performance from test counts.
